capabilities.ui: business web app and reviewer renderer

limitations: A transfer is delivered only when the host publishes its message through Messaging and records the outcome with waypoint.transfer.settle; the App never sends by itself.
An unknown delivery acknowledgement leaves the transfer pending for reconciliation; there is no automatic refund or republish.
Points are earned only as seeded history; no card spending, buying or selling points, elite status or expiry in Waypoint.
Text only; one member per App instance.
